BACKUP_IMAGE applies to FLASH_INPAGE, HTML5_BANNER, all RICH_MEDIA, and all VPAID creatives. Applicable to DISPLAY when the primary asset type is not HTML_IMAGE. ADDITIONAL_IMAGE and ADDITIONAL_FLASH apply to FLASH_INPAGE creatives. OTHER refers to assets from sources other than Campaign Manager, such as Studio uploaded assets, applicable to all RICH_MEDIA and all VPAID creatives. PARENT_VIDEO refers to videos uploaded by the user in Campaign Manager and is applicable to INSTREAM_VIDEO and VPAID_LINEAR_VIDEO creatives.
